_meta.note: Championships are region-level and apply to any event. Pick an event with --event (e.g. 1500m_men). The rankings URL is built from rankings_url_template using the event's discipline + gender. Per-event qualification config (quota, defending champion / auto_invites, optional window override) lives under 'events'. 'data_source' aliases the ranking-list fetch to another championship's cache (same list, different qualification overlay). 'contested_events_only': events absent from 'events' are NOT on this championship's programme (the UI shows 'not_contested_note' for them). short_label / scope_label / rank_label are presentation strings for the UI tabs. 'archived': true hides a finished championship from the site (meta, bundle, weekly refresh) while keeping its config loadable. 'qualification_feed' points at WA's own 'road to' feed; where a snapshot exists it overlays quota / entry_standard / window / auto_invites and supplies standard_achievers (see feed.py); the values under 'events' are then the fallback. Per-event 'entry_standard' (+ 'alt_entry_standards' for road/mile alternatives) drives the entry-standard route; an auto_invite with source 'manual' is hand-maintained, not from the feed.

world.label: World Ranking
world.note: Global World Athletics ranking (all nations). General-ranking questions only; no quota/qualification.

road_to_beijing.label: Road to Beijing (2027 World Athletics Championships)
road_to_beijing.quota_source: World Athletics 'Qualification System and Entry Standards - Beijing 2027' (May 2026): 'Target number of athletes / teams by event' + 'Entry Standards' tables. Overlaid weekly by WA's 'Road to Beijing 27' feed (getChampionshipQualifications, competition 7216591): quota = entryNumber, entry standard, window, the byes WA labels (Defending World Champion) and the athletes marked 'Qualified by Entry Standard'. Entries with source 'manual' (the 2026 Ultimate Championship winners, wildcards per the qualification system) are hand-maintained until WA's feed carries them; the 2027 Diamond League winner must be added after the 2027 DL final.
road_to_beijing.qualification_note: Quota is the target field. Entry-standard achievers and wildcards (Defending World Champion, 2026 Ultimate Championship winner, 2027 Diamond League winner) are in first; the world rankings fill the remaining places. Max 3 per country across all routes (4 if one is a wildcard). Who has achieved the standard comes from WA's feed snapshot; the ranking fill uses the current world list, whose rolling window only matches the qualification period at the 22 Aug 2027 rank date. Area champions (a conditional route) are not modelled.
road_to_beijing.entry_standard_rules: Standard marks count only in Category C meets and above, inside the qualification window, in the main event or a listed road/mile alternative; indoor (short-track) marks count for the ranking but not for the standard.

qualification_feed._note: WA competition + event ids for getChampionshipQualifications (see feed.py).

road_to_birmingham.archived_note: 2026 European Athletics Championships (Birmingham, Aug 2026) are over.
road_to_birmingham.label: Road to Birmingham (2026 European Athletics Championships)
road_to_birmingham.quota_source: European Athletics 'Qualification System and Entry Standards' (Birmingham 2026), 'Target number of athletes / teams per event' table.
road_to_birmingham.qualification_note: Quota is the TOTAL target field; world rankings only fill what remains after entry-standard achievers, finishing-position qualifiers, the defending-champion wildcard and approved unqualified athletes. This tool treats the field as ranking-only (champion bye + 3-per-country cap), so it over-counts ranking places. Defending champions are the Rome 2024 European Outdoor Champions (wildcard applies only if entered by their federation; some may not compete). 10000m uses an 18-month qualification window.

road_to_ultimate.archived_note: 2026 World Athletics Ultimate Championship (Budapest, 11-13 Sep 2026) is over.
road_to_ultimate.label: Road to Budapest (2026 World Athletics Ultimate Championship)
road_to_ultimate.quota_source: World Athletics 'Road to the Ultimate' qualification feed (getChampionshipQualifications, competition 7212925): quota = entryNumber per event; wildcards = the Paris 2024 Olympic and Tokyo 2025 World champions per WA's published labels.
road_to_ultimate.qualification_note: Invitational: wildcards (Olympic/World champions) plus world-ranking fill-up. NO country cap. Only 26 individual events were contested; the 10000m and 3000m steeplechase were not on the programme.
road_to_ultimate.not_contested_note: This event will not be competed at the World Athletics Ultimate Championship 2026.
